statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
